notes: Texas Senate terms were reset after 2021/2023 redistricting: all 31 seats ran in 2022; on Jan 11 2023 senators drew lots (odd = 4-year term, so up again in 2026; even = 2-year term, up in 2024 and then 2028). The 16 seats on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot are therefore exactly the 4-year-term draws, NOT an odd/even district split. Ballotpedia's 2026 table, the complement of Ballotpedia's 2024 table, the Texas Tribune's published lottery list (mapped to districts via LRL 88th-Legislature membership) and the LRL 89th-Legislature term-end years were compared; see cross_checks. Special-election effects: SD9 (Hancock resigned; Rehmet (D) won the Jan 31 2026 runoff) and SD4 (Creighton resigned; Ligon (R) won the May 2 2026 special) were already 4-year seats scheduled for 2026, so their winners are running in the regular 2026 election as incumbents. SD22 (Birdwell resigned May 29 2026) was also scheduled for 2026; a special election for the unexpired remainder is held concurrently on Nov 3 2026 with the same two candidates as the regular race. No special election changed the set of seats up. The Texas SOS candidate portal could not be used as an official cross-check because it lists no 2026 elections (see cross_checks.sos_portal_2026_elections_listed).
